answer: Every agent ID gets audited in the same random minute each week. Each ID receives its own memory-hard puzzle, seeded by its key, and must answer within ninety seconds, so no reply can echo another ID's work. All audits fire at once, which means a farm cannot rotate one rig across its fakes. A hundred fakes need a hundred rigs ready for a two-minute gale. A missed audit freezes that ID's earnings. Keeping a garden of fakes means paying peak hardware for each one, every week.
